core_categories: Retail Pharmacy; Health and Beauty Retail; Pharmaceutical Wholesale; Beauty Salon Franchise
specialty_focus: Clicks Group is a South African healthcare, beauty, and lifestyle retail and wholesale company. It operates the country's largest retail pharmacy chain (Clicks) with over 1,000 stores and 790 in-store pharmacies, alongside a wholesale pharmaceutical distribution arm (UPD) serving independent pharmacies and private hospitals. The group does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices; its core business is retail pharmacy and health/beauty retail.
key_brands: Clicks, UPD, Sorbet, M-Kem, The Body Shop, others
